course.title: Medicine MBBS/BSc | Imperial College London
quotes: Qualification MBBS/BSc Duration 6 years Start date October 2027 UCAS course code A100
A*AA including Chemistry and Biology, with A* in one of these subjects (A-levels)
A* and A in Biology and Chemistry (A* in either) A in a third subject
Minimum entry standard 38 points To include: 6 in Biology at higher level 6 in Chemistry at higher level

EITHER 5, 5, 5, 5, 4 to include 5 in Biology, 5 in Chemistry and 5 in either Calculus BC or a relevant science subject OR 5, 5, 5 to include Biology and Chemistry Award of acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g., US High School Diploma) Either 1470 in SAT or 32 in ACT.
Our minimum entry standard is 91% overall, to include: 95% / 90% in Biology and Chemistry (grades any order) 90% in Mathematics or Physics
India: 12th Standard CBSE - AISSCE or CISCE - ISC boards
Our minimum entry standard is 1.5 overall, to include the following abiturprufung exams: 14 in Chemistry 14 in Biology
You will need to take the University Clinical Aptitude Test (UCAT) to study this course.
we then begin inviting candidates to attend our Multiple Mini Interviews (MMIs).
For 2026 entry, the number of Home places is 271 and Overseas places was 74.
Application deadlines - Thursday 15 October 2026 at 18.00 (UK time)
All applicants must meet our higher level English language requirement.
